title: VaultAuditRepository
responsibility: Appends Credential Vault request and lease events to a private journal with allowlisted fields only, never secret values.

inputs.name: VaultAuditRepository.append.entry
inputs.description: Request id, item, site, action, method, recipe digest, host and optional lease and cause; other fields are dropped.

inputs.name: VaultAuditRepository.append.event
inputs.description: Event name, such as request, approval, delivery or lease-end.

outputs.name: VaultAuditRepository.append
outputs.description: The record written, with its event and ISO time; the line is fsynced.

outputs.name: VaultAuditRepository.read
outputs.description: Every record in order, or none when the journal does not exist.

outputs.name: VaultAuditRepository.outstanding
outputs.description: The last event of each request or lease with no terminal event.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 500 'Refused a malformed audit record.' when a field is not an allowlisted identifier, digest or enum.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: 'Partial audit write.' when the line is not written whole.

errors.name: NodeJS.ErrnoException
errors.description: A file-system error when the journal cannot be opened, written or synced.

errors.name: NodeJS.ErrnoException
errors.description: A file-system error other than a missing journal.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: A journal line that is not JSON.
